messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "doctor may start on cholesterol-lowering diet before giving drug"
set: ["doctor may start on cholesterol-lowering diet before giving drug", "follow a cholesterol-lowering diet plan", "tell doctor if on low-sodium diet", "doctor may start on low dose and raise it gradually", "treatment may include diet", "may start to feel relief on first day", "make liquid before taking or giving it", "start steroid medicine before levothyroxine", "stay on diet when taking medicine", "tell doctor if changed diet", "edema may be most efficiently and safely mobilized by giving this drug on 2 to 4 consecutive days each week", "doctor will start on suitable dose and adjust gradually based on blood tests", "your treatment may include a special diet", "ask doctor before stopping", "start treatment with steroid (glucocorticoid) medicine before starting levothyroxine", "start levothyroxine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
